summary: Retest of the dual-fee (SAGEian/Non-SAGEian) affiliation pricing release: 8/8 acceptance-matrix criteria re-verified. 3 backend pytest files (13 tests) re-run against the live server/DB, all passing. 6 existing named browser checks re-run by name only (no script resent), all passing.

checks.name: registration-locked-event-hides-selectors
checks.evidence: Re-run by name (reran-persisted). /registration/dance-competition shows locked event/category, both affiliation prices, no event/category selectors. Screenshots: locked-summary, after-switch-non-sageian.

checks.criterion: Affiliation selection never clears the amount
checks.name: non-sageian-keeps-fee-desktop
checks.evidence: Re-run by name (reran-persisted). SAGEian selection shows fee, switching to Non-SAGEian keeps amount visible. Screenshots: sageian-selected, non-sageian-selected.

checks.criterion: Affiliation selection never clears the amount (mobile)
checks.name: non-sageian-fee-visible-mobile
checks.evidence: Re-run by name (reran-persisted). Non-SAGEian fee remains visible at mobile viewport. Screenshot: non-sageian-chess-mobile.

checks.name: test_tscheck_affiliation_pricing.py
checks.evidence: pytest -q tests/test_tscheck_affiliation_pricing.py tests/test_tscheck_migration_dual_fee_columns.py tests/test_tscheck_secret_safety.py -> '13 passed in 1.09s' against live server (localhost:8001 healthy, CI 127.0.0.1:8091 200). Confirms Non-SAGEian persists total_amount 250, SAGEian persists 100, tampered posted IDs/amount cannot override server-locked pricing.

checks.name: ci-admin-dual-fee-management
checks.evidence: Re-run by name (reran-persisted). Event Builder saves both fees; Events list and public event detail display both. Screenshots: admin-events-list-dual-fee, public-event-detail-dual-fee.

checks.name: test_tscheck_migration_dual_fee_columns.py
checks.evidence: Included in the same pytest run above (13 passed). Migration 000006 adds/copies both fee columns; fresh seeds populate them.

checks.criterion: All public and registration pages are mobile responsive
checks.name: ci-public-pages-mobile-no-overflow
checks.evidence: Re-run by name (reran-persisted) at 390px: home, events, event-detail, registration-general, registration-locked, gallery, admin-login, scanner-login all rendered without body overflow. 8 screenshots captured.

checks.criterion: Admin and scanner are mobile responsive
checks.name: ci-admin-scanner-mobile-responsive
checks.evidence: Re-run by name (reran-persisted). Admin dashboard and events route tabs (sticky horizontal scroll) and scanner login all fit at mobile viewport without body overflow. Screenshots: admin-dashboard-mobile, admin-events-tabs-mobile, scanner-login-mobile.

checks.name: test_tscheck_secret_safety.py
checks.evidence: Included in the same pytest run above (13 passed). Artifacts contain no real .env/credentials; production template uses placeholders and prod/gateway mode; no live charge occurs.
